say:2:1630417001:1.text: Ugh, you again! What, here to gloat?
say:2:1630417001:1.source_cn: 是你！你来这里做什么？幸灾乐祸吗？
say:2:1630417001:1.male: Ugh, you again! What, here to gloat?
say:2:1630417001:1.female: Ugh, you again! What, here to gloat?

say:3:1630417002:1.text: Wait... is that—oh Dura above, it's Magister Merlin! In the flesh! Perfect timing! Magister, please, I need a fair judgment here!
say:3:1630417002:1.source_cn: 天哪，是梅林大人！我居然见到梅林大人了！您、您来得正好...
say:3:1630417002:1.male: Wait... is that—oh Dura above, it's Magister Merlin! In the flesh! Perfect timing! Magister, please, I need a fair judgment here!
say:3:1630417002:1.female: Wait... is that—oh Dura above, it's Magister Merlin! In the flesh! Perfect timing! Magister, please, I need a fair judgment here!

say:5:1630417004:1.text: Magister, this merchant sold me a robe he claimed was "exclusive to elite mages"...
say:5:1630417004:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，这个奸商高价卖了我一件魔法袍，还标榜高级魔法...
say:5:1630417004:1.male: Magister, this merchant sold me a robe he claimed was "exclusive to elite mages"...
say:5:1630417004:1.female: Magister, this merchant sold me a robe he claimed was "exclusive to elite mages"...

say:6:1630417005:1.text: Then I wore it to class, and guess what? Half the school was wearing the exact same "exclusive" robe!
say:6:1630417005:1.source_cn: 结果我穿回去，发现半个学院的人都有这件高级魔法袍！
say:6:1630417005:1.male: Then I wore it to class, and guess what? Half the school was wearing the exact same "exclusive" robe!
say:6:1630417005:1.female: Then I wore it to class, and guess what? Half the school was wearing the exact same "exclusive" robe!

say:7:1630417006:1.text: And get this, he said it wouldn't fray or fade. I washed it once, and now my white shirt is charcoal grey!
say:7:1630417006:1.source_cn: 不仅如此，他还宣称这件魔法袍不起球不掉色，可我一洗就掉...
say:7:1630417006:1.male: And get this, he said it wouldn't fray or fade. I washed it once, and now my white shirt is charcoal grey!
say:7:1630417006:1.female: And get this, he said it wouldn't fray or fade. I washed it once, and now my white shirt is charcoal grey!

say:8:1630417007:1.text: Th-that's not on me! Your shirt was probably cursed or something!
say:8:1630417007:1.source_cn: 那、那绝对是你的衬衫有问题！

say:9:1630417008:1.text: Cursed? It was a plain white shirt!
say:9:1630417008:1.source_cn: 怎么可能！那可是白色的衬衫！

say:10:1630417009:1.text: Maybe you enchanted it? Weird things happen with laundry magic, you know.
say:10:1630417009:1.source_cn: 说不定是你往上面附了什么魔法呢。

say:11:1630417010:1.text: You think I'd cast a coloring spell on my own white shirt—just to come here and start trouble with you?!
say:11:1630417010:1.source_cn: 你的意思是说，我自己往自己的衣服上附魔法，故意把自己的...

choice_prompt:12:1630417010.text: You think I'd cast a coloring spell on my own white shirt—just to come here and start trouble with you?!
choice_prompt:12:1630417010.source_cn: 你的意思是说，我自己往自己的衣服上附魔法，故意把自己的衣服弄染色了吗？！

say:13:1630417011:1.text: Using my own words against me, huh?
say:13:1630417011:1.source_cn: 你，你居然用我的话来对付我！
say:13:1630417011:1.male: Using my own words against me, huh?
say:13:1630417011:1.female: Using my own words against me, huh?

say:14:1630417012:1.text: Cut the nonsense. Give my money back!

say:15:1630417013:1.text: Fine, fine! Ugh, I knew I shouldn't have gotten out of bed today...
say:15:1630417013:1.source_cn: 好吧，好吧。我真是……惹了瘟神了。

choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 做生意就是要公平竞争
